# Fisher Scientific

> > Fisher Scientific is a leading global provider of lab supplies, research equipment, and production essentials for scientific, healthcare, and clinical applications.

Fisher Scientific offers a comprehensive catalog of laboratory consumables, cell culture supplies, and diagnostic equipment from trusted brands like Corning and Thermo Scientific. The platform serves research institutions, healthcare facilities, and production environments with same-day shipping, bulk ordering tools, and supplier diversity programs.

## Shopping & Product Catalog

- [Fisher Scientific Homepage](https://www.fishersci.com): Main entry point featuring lab supplies, research equipment, and Corning products with same-day shipping.
- [Fisher Scientific Home](https://www.fishersci.com/us/en/home.html): Lab supplies, research equipment, and production essentials with product catalog and promotional deals.
- [Brand Directory](https://www.fishersci.com/us/en/browse/brands): Alphabetical listing of product suppliers and manufacturers available through Fisher Scientific.
- [Corning Vacuum Filter/Storage Bottle System](https://www.fishersci.com/shop/products/corning-disposable-sterile-filter-systems-24/09761108): Corning 1000 mL vacuum filter/storage bottle system with specifications and ordering options.
- [Corning Costar 6-Well Cell Culture Plates](https://www.fishersci.com/shop/products/costar-cell-culture-plates-1/0720083): Corning tissue-culture-treated 6-well plates for cell culture applications, individually wrapped and sterile.
- [Corning Stripette Serological Pipettes](https://www.fishersci.com/shop/products/stripette-paper-wrapped-disposable-polystyrene-serological-pipettes-7/07200575): Corning disposable polystyrene serological pipettes, 25 mL, sterile with paper/plastic wrapping.

## Order Management & Accounts

- [Order Status & History](https://www.fishersci.com/store1/orders): Look up order status, view order history, and manage customer account information.
- [Rapid Order Entry](https://www.fishersci.com/store1/rapidorder): Bulk order entry tool supporting rapid product searches and file uploads for efficient purchasing.

- [Fisher Healthcare Clinical Lab Solutions](https://www.fishersci.com/us/en/healthcare-products.html): Clinical lab equipment, diagnostic tests, and healthcare solutions through Fisher Healthcare division.
